nodes.label: Novedades Query Storm Mitigation (B1-B7)
nodes.rationale: Opening /novedades fired ~50 requests in ~2s saturating the Supabase free-tier pool; fixed by caching avatar signed URLs by path with 300s TTL, session-wide Set dedupe on mark_story_viewed, 30s staleTime gating focus refetches, bounded retries with Zustand outage banner, and 10s auth-refresh race timeout.

nodes.label: Supabase Health Outage Detection and Recovery Probe
nodes.rationale: Detects PostgREST 5-class SQLSTATE/PGRST codes and HTTP 5xx errors in QueryCache.onError, pauses focusManager, and probes every 15s to prevent retry amplification.
